column13: This dataset provides taxonomic information on prevalent microbial species identified in a study, including their classification and prevalence within the sample population.
specie: A concatenated string representing the full taxonomic hierarchy from kingdom to strain, separated by the pipe (|) character.
sum_species: The count of each species within the sample population, considering only those with a relative abundance of ?0.1%.
kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species, strain: Individual columns detailing the taxonomic classification of each entry, allowing for analysis at different taxonomic levels.
Each row represents a unique bacterial strain identified in the study, along with its complete taxonomic classification and prevalence count.

Only species detected in at least 10% of the sample population with a relative abundance of ?0.1% are included, ensuring the dataset focuses on prevalent microbes that may have significant functional roles in the microbial community.
